acceptance_criteria: Three documented `Kernel` methods, implemented for `OcctKernel`: `body_count(&self, s) -> Result<usize, KernelError>`: number of distinct solids in `s` (0 for a lone face). `bodies(&self, s) -> Result<Vec<Self::Shape>, KernelError>`: each solid of `s` as its own shape, sorted by bounding-box minimum (x, then y, then z). `combine(&self, op: BooleanOp, target, tools: &[Self::Shape]) -> Result<Self::Shape, KernelError>`: the same result as applying `op` to the target with each tool in turn, in order. The inputs are unchanged. New shim code (if any) is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` call is in `ffi` with a SAFETY comment.

Tests (behind `occt`), volumes within 1e-6 relative, points within 1e-6: two disjoint boxes union (body_count 2, bodies sorted); join with two tools (volume 3000); cut with two cylinders (3000 - 80pi); cut that splits (2 bodies, min x 0 then 20); intersect with two tools (volume 250); the target and tools are unchanged afterwards (same volumes).

Errors, each with a test and never a panic: no tools, or a tool or target that is not a solid (a face from `make_face`), is `InvalidInput`, checked before the backend; an intersect with no common volume is `EmptyResult`. `body_count` of a face is `Ok(0)`, and `bodies` of a face is `Ok` of an empty list.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M3-10a: Kernel multi-body shapes: body count, split into bodies, combine a target with several tool bodies
